Description: Events file for the Poland movie, detailing the timing and type of events during the fMRI scan.

onset.Description: Onset time of the event in seconds relative to the start of the scan

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds

trial_type.Description: Type of event: onset_movie marks the start of the movie stimulus, offset_movie marks the end

stim_file.Description: Filename of the stimulus video presented during this task
